name: verify_identity
description: Checks one identity answer from the person on the call against the lender's record. Returns verified (true or false) and attempts_left. It never returns the correct answer.

answer.description: The answer as said. For birth_year, four digits such as 1991. For registered_city, the city name such as Nagpur.

execution_message_description: A very short line in the borrower's current language, such as 'Ek second.' or 'One moment.'

name: send_payment_link
description: Sends the official payment link for the overdue EMI to the borrower's registered mobile number. Works only after identity is verified. Returns response_text to tell the borrower.

channel.description: Use sms unless the borrower asks for WhatsApp.

execution_message_description: A very short line in the borrower's current language, such as 'Main link bhej rahi hoon.' or 'Sending the link now.'

name: log_promise_to_pay
description: Records the borrower's promise to pay. Accepts a date within the next seven days and an amount above zero and not more than the total outstanding. Returns accepted, or a reason it was rejected.

date_iso.description: The promised payment date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-10-24.

amount_inr.description: The promised amount in rupees, digits only, for example 4500.

mode.description: How the borrower plans to pay. Use payment_link if they will pay online or by UPI.

execution_message_description: A very short line in the borrower's current language, such as 'Main note kar leti hoon.' or 'Let me note that.'

name: flag_hardship
description: Records that the borrower is facing a hardship and queues a call from a person on the collections team who can discuss options. Pauses automated calls for medical and bereavement cases.

category.description: The kind of hardship. income_drop covers business loss or reduced pay.

note.description: One or two plain English sentences on what the borrower said.

name: log_dispute
description: Records that the borrower disputes the dues or says they already paid, and sends it to a person for checking.

note.description: Plain English details. For already_paid, include the payment date, how they paid and any reference number they gave.

name: schedule_callback
description: Books a callback. Accepts times between 08:00 and 18:45 India time within the next seven days. Returns accepted, or a reason and the nearest allowed time.

datetime_iso.description: The callback time in India time as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, for example 2026-10-22T17:30.

name: escalate_to_human
description: Hands the case to a person on the collections team. Always works. Returns queued and live_transfer_available, which says whether the call can be transferred right now.

reason.description: Why the case needs a person. plan_change_request covers waivers, discounts, settlements and dates more than seven days away.

note.description: One plain English sentence of context for the person who picks this up.

name: transfer_call
description: Transfers a live phone call to the collections desk. Use only after escalate_to_human returned live_transfer_available as true.
execution_message_description: One short line in the borrower's current language saying you are connecting them to a person now.

name: end_call
description: Ends the call. Use after your closing line, when the borrower says goodbye, after handling a third person or wrong number, when identity could not be verified, or when abuse continues after one request to stop.
